text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim with reasons across paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a more controlled line of argument with ideas grouped into paragraphs instead of repeated loosely connected statements."},{"evidence":"some causal wording like \"because\" and \"that\"","quality":"development","description":"It gives a somewhat fuller explanation of its position by linking reasons to outcomes rather than only restating the same point."},{"evidence":"sentences such as \"I do not support it because i feel like...\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"It shows more ability to build complete multi-clause sentences even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"phrases like \"from my point of view\" and \"In my life\" omitted/varied","quality":"cohesion","description":"It uses transitions and discourse markers more effectively to connect ideas and signal argument flow."},{"evidence":"wording like \"maturing,\" \"organization,\" \"responsibility\"","quality":"word choice","description":"It uses a slightly more academic vocabulary range that better fits an argumentative essay."}]}
